guide.name: Sunny — word discovery
guide.voice_prompt: A bright, friendly girl cartoon voice, childlike and about eight years old, speaking native General American English. Clear round vowels and crisp consonants, a smiling light mid-high register, curious and inviting. Playful rising and falling intonation with expressive noun emphasis, unhurried and very easy for preschoolers to imitate. Natural child speech with correct pronunciation, no lisp, no baby babble, no whisper or shrill shouting.
guide.preview_text: A tree! A strawberry! A bear! A tiger! Great! You found it!

pip.name: Pip — colors and playful actions
pip.voice_prompt: A lively little boy cartoon penguin voice, childlike and about seven years old, native General American English. A clear bright springy tone with a smile and joyful curiosity. Playful rhythmic delivery, colorful pitch movement and rounded fully spoken words. Celebrate discoveries with delighted surprise and friendly energy. Clearly understandable to preschool children; never mumbled, shrieked, mechanically squeaky or baby babbled.
pip.preview_text: Blue! Yellow! Green! Your jelly is ready! Great! Let us play!

teddy.name: Teddy — requests and kindness
teddy.voice_prompt: A cuddly young teddy bear cartoon boy, childlike and about six years old, speaking native General American English. Soft rounded warm mid-high voice, slightly mellow and plush, clearly distinct from a bright girl narrator. Gently eager requests with expressive emphasis on the object. Delighted grateful thanks, and kind reassuring playful mistakes. Clear slow-enough diction with smiling pitch variation; no adult bass, growling, baby babble, lisp or shouting.
teddy.preview_text: A strawberry, please! A tree, please! Thank you! Oops! Try again.

warm_guide.name: Warm companion — approved default guide
warm_guide.voice_prompt: An adult man in his thirties, warm rounded medium-low baritone, softly resonant and comforting without booming bass. A kind playful companion with a relaxed smile, like a friendly storybook bear or a father playing together. Gentle, softly spoken but fully voiced, never stern or authoritative. Native General American English. Clear accurate diction for preschool children. Soft conversational delivery, no shrillness, squeaks, shouting or commanding cadence.
warm_guide.preview_text: Hello, little friend. Let's play together. Can you find the red balloon?
